beats.event: Born to Queen Maya at Lumbini amid prophecies of greatness
Raised in sheltered luxury inside the Kapilavastu palace
Marries Yashodhara; a son, Rahula, is born to him
Chariot rides reveal an old man, sick man, corpse, and ascetic
In the great departure he leaves palace, wife, and son
Cuts off his hair and sends his charioteer Chandaka home
Studies under Alara Kalama and Uddaka Ramaputta; finds it insufficient
Six years of extreme austerity with five companions nearly kills him
Accepts food from Sujata; the five ascetics abandon him
Sits beneath the Bodhi tree resolved not to rise until awake
Mara's armies and daughters assault and tempt him
Defeats Mara and attains full enlightenment
First sermon at Deer Park converts the five ascetics
Establishes the sangha; teaches for decades across the Ganges plain
At Kushinagar he passes into final parinirvana
His relics are distributed; the faith is founded
